svg.title: GainSec — printed circuit board profile
svg.desc: Top-down two-layer green printed circuit board representing the GitHub profile of GainSec (GainSec): four tones (mask over FR-4 #1a3222, mask over copper #2f451e, pad metal #b39c00, silk #e6e6e6). U1 (LQFP-100, the profile) marked GainSec REV A 1337. Zone 1 "SECURITY RESEARCH", a dashed silk courtyard of 9 TSSOP-8 chips: U4 Flock Safety [×4 2638]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "Flock Safety" (anti-crime-ecosystem-research, BirdShot, Flock-Safety-Trap-Shooter-Sniffer-Alarm, flock-safety-falcon-sparrow-alpr-edl-firehose), latest push 2638; U5 Verkada [×5 2641]: 5 repositories from bullets mentioning "Verkada" (verkada-verkracked-alarm-hub-local-framework, verkada-verkracked-subghz-framework, verkada-verkracked-bullet-cam-cloud-emulator, VerkEye, verkada-verkracked-ambrella-CB62-firmwaredumper), latest push 2641; U6 Digital Ally [×4 2627]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "Digital Ally" (DigitalAlly-ThermoVu-Uniview-Security-Research, Uniview-LAPI-Research-Toolkit, onvif-enum, tensorflow-generic-harness), latest push 2627; U7 ThermoVu [×4 2627]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "ThermoVu" (DigitalAlly-ThermoVu-Uniview-Security-Research, Uniview-LAPI-Research-Toolkit, onvif-enum, tensorflow-generic-harness), latest push 2627; U8 Uniview [×4 2627]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "Uniview" (DigitalAlly-ThermoVu-Uniview-Security-Research, Uniview-LAPI-Research-Toolkit, onvif-enum, tensorflow-generic-harness), latest push 2627; U9 Tridium Niagara [×1 2226]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "Tridium Niagara" (CVE-2017-16744-and-CVE-2017-16748-Tridium-Niagara), latest push 2226; U10 Kapsch TrafficCom [×1 2536]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "V2X" (Phrack-72-Raw-Output-V2X), latest push 2536; U11 MacOS [×1 2634]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "MacOS" (macos-printer-simulator-security-research), latest push 2634; U12 AutoPro [×1 2627]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "AutoPro" (3rdParty-Carplay-AndroidAuto-Dongle-Security-Research), latest push 2627; 3 more not placed. Vendor board: 9 of 12 vendor chips placed in 1 zone (1 column, row pitch 3.64 mm); 3 did not fit (silk +3 MORE). Each chip stands for the repositories linked from the README bullets that mention the vendor; its laser marking is the repository count and their latest push (YYWW). 19 of the 60 repositories in the data belong to at least one vendor; the matrix, test points and totals cover those. One 0.25 mm bus from U1 runs down every column and taps pin 1 of each chip. DS2 7×12 amber LED matrix, silk PUSH/WK = repositories pushed per ISO week (repos[].pushedAt — each repository's latest push, so a repository counts at most once) for the 12 weeks 2026-08-03 to 2026-10-22; each row is one week drawn as a bar lit from the left, one LED per event; 8 in total, max 3 in a week. Counts: W32 1, W33 0, W34 1, W35 0, W36 0, W37 2, W38 1, W39 0, W40 0, W41 3, W42 0, W43 0. No contribution data is used. Mobile curated composition: U1, the transposed DS2 matrix and D1 HB / D2 TX on top, one column of zone chips below; marking block, J3 UART and its harness, test points, bargraph, driver and flash are omitted at this width. Net list (H/V/45° routing, vias at layer changes): BUS U1–U4…U12 0.25 mm. 9 vendor chips on the board; 41 of the 60 repositories in the data match no vendor. 8 repositories pushed in the 12-week matrix window. Reduced motion: only the heartbeat LED blinks. Data captured 2026-10-22T22:21:17.411Z.
